- To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)

- Body: the proposed rate is $2,356 a seat, the figure comes from Dana, and you approved sharing it with him. It also asks him to keep the rate within the deal team and finance.

No separate approval was needed. Per-seat rates normally need sign-off from you or June before going to anyone else, and your message counts as that sign-off. Hollis's address is a pemberline.com one, so Ruth doesn't need to approve the mail either.
